issues: 轰鸣段是灰色占位卡片飞过灰色 dashboard，没有内容也没有情绪，读不出「喧闹」
切点前后都是同一种灰色 UI，反差只剩「动 vs 不动」，猛切的力量被削弱
死寂段是一张通用列表页，没有任何信息，不像一个高潮的句号
飞卡只有 5 张，切点前画面并没有被填满
changes: 轰鸣段讲「被通知淹没」：暗红余烬舞台中央 300px 未读计数从 212 ease-in 加速冲向 1,284，背后红色辉光与同心涟漪随动势增强
12 张虚构通知卡（构建失败 / @here / P1 告警 / 逾期账单…）两轮从中心朝镜头加速冲脸（scale 0.5→2.6，第二轮更快更密），沿各自飞行方向按瞬时速度做方向性模糊
背景 ease-in 推近 1→1.5 + 滚动 2°、暗角随动势收紧，切点前 3f 仍在最猛处
42f 一帧硬切到 sand 暖米色静止海报：420px「0 unread.」+ 一句副文案 + 已打开的 Do Not Disturb 开关——内容、色温、明暗同时翻转
死寂段是纯静态子树（无颗粒、无呼吸），停满 93f 帧级真静止
issuesEn: The roar was grey placeholder cards flying over a grey dashboard, with no content and no emotion, so it never read as 'noise'
Both sides of the cut used the same grey UI, so the contrast was only moving vs still and the smash lost its force
The silent half was a generic list page with no information, not a climactic full stop
Only five cards flew, so the frame wasn't full before the cut
changesEn: The roar is about drowning in notifications: on a dark ember stage a 300px unread counter accelerates (ease-in) from 212 to 1,284 while the red glow and concentric ripples behind it intensify

Twelve fictional notifications (build failed, @here, P1 alert, overdue invoice…) fly from the centre at the camera in two waves (scale 0.5→2.6, the second faster and denser), each with directional blur along its path driven by instantaneous speed
The background pushes 1→1.5 with a 2° roll on ease-in and the vignette tightens with the energy; three frames before the cut it is still at peak speed
At 42f a single hard cut to a warm sand still poster: a 420px '0 unread.', one line of copy and a Do Not Disturb toggle switched on; content, colour temperature and brightness all flip at once
The silent half is a fully static subtree (no grain, no breathing) held for 93f, truly still frame by frame
